evidence.reason: Line 33 reuses any frozen `env` directly. `Object.freeze` prevents property changes but does not snapshot accessor values: a frozen record may still contain a getter reading `process.env`, so later reads can observe ambient changes. This contradicts the documented guarantee that the environment record is copied and frozen so an in-place `process.env` mutation after entry cannot move a read inside the run. The smallest compatible fix is to always materialize `{ ...env }` once before freezing/storing.
